text:
QUOTE: "A frontend callback approves every call that reaches it, because `check_approval` ignores the callback's result. The deny list is the only hard block. The allow list only suppresses the callback."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says only the deny list blocks and that the callback approves everything, so a tool on neither list runs. It adds that with no callback wired, an unlisted call is denied unless `auto_approve` is set.
